Remark
[Equivalent norm on $W_0^{1,p}$; the borderline case $p=n$] ↗ thm:poincare-w01p-subcritical 1. ch5:5.6-rem-2\group Sobolev Inequalities

(i) If $U$ is bounded, $\| Du\| _{L^p(U)}$ and $\| u\| _{W^{1,p}(U)}$ are equivalent norms on $W_0^{1,p}(U)$.

(ii) For $n>1$, the borderline embedding $W^{1,n}(U)\subset L^\infty (U)$ fails. On $U=B^0(0,1)$, \[ u(x)=\log \log \left(1+\frac{1}{|x|}\right) \] belongs to $W^{1,n}(U)$ but not to $L^\infty (U)$.
